newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan blue chips fall on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan blue chips fall on retail selling.

text.p: Retail selling depressed high-priced Sri Lankan blue chips in early trade, brokers said.
Lanka Orix Leasing fell 6.82 percent or 15 rupees to 205, Commercial Bank 2.38 percent or five rupees to 205.
"Retailers are taking profit since these shares have risen over 15 percent in the last three weeks," said a local broker.

Colombo stocks have gained steadily due to good growth expectations, easing interest rates due to improved money supply after the Central Bank cut reserve ratios, and since the government and opposition agreed to work together to end the ethnic crisis, analysts said.
